name: - Nmbplatform
fix_description: In getTokenAmountForToken, uses manipulable on-chain price/balance values. Fix: use TWAP oracle or add flash-loan protection.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step DeFi attack involving pre-positioned staking across three reward contracts, time advancement, a flash loan plus flash swap, and reward-price manipulation before harvesting and unwinding positions. It requires understanding protocol-specific reward accounting and token price dependencies across several contracts, but the attack flow is still relatively direct once the vulnerable reward logic is identified.
